timelinePolicy: Use raw period labels such as 月姬前, 月姬, Remake前, 同人版, 重制版; no invented exact dates beyond source text.
notFoundPolicy: If a main-cast source lacks appearance/equipment/ability/combat/relationship/timeline detail, emit not-found-in-source marker rather than filling from memory.
